item.title: 20 Years Ago, the Best Sci-Fi Show of the Century Delivered the Most Epic Space Battle in TV History
item.dc:creator: Corey Plante
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective about old sci-fi show, not new substantive content.] Twenty years ago, Battlestar Galactica topped the Adama Maneuver by transforming the Pegasus into an enormous battering ram.
item.content:encoded: Two decades later, this spectacle from Battlestar Galacticaseason 3’s “Exodus, Part 2” remains unforgettable sci-fi TV. It’s dazzling and horrifying, and still one of the coolest things ever broadcast on science-fiction television. From a tactical standpoint, the “Adama Maneuver” is absolutely bonkers and one of the riskiest spaceship tactics, perhaps ever (sorry, Vice-Admiral Holdo). What if the ship had gotten torn apart from ripping through the atmosphere? What if the FTL drive malfunctioned or didn’t activate in time? Somehow, it’s also not even the most visually impressive sequence in the episode.

item.title: Pokémon Go Wild Area 2026 event schedule, habitat spawns, and bonuses
item.dc:creator: Julia Lee
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's everything you need to know about Pokémon Go's Wild Area 2026 event, including the habitats, spawns, and bonuses.
item.content:encoded: Pokémon Go's big global Wild Area 2026 event is finally here, running on Nov. 14 and 15 from 10 a.m. until 6 p.m. in your local time. This event features the debut of Gigantamax Duraludon, as well as Dynamax Dialga and Palkia. Safari Balls and mighty Pokémon also make a return from the previous years' Wild Area events, which means you can find some powerful Pokémon roaming about.

item.title: How to get mighty Pokémon in Pokémon Go
item.dc:creator: Julia Lee
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Special "mighty" Pokémon appear during the Wild Area event. We explain what they are, their special moves, and a mighty Pokémon list to target.
item.content:encoded: Mighty Pokémon are particularly strong Pokémon that you can find during the Pokémon GoWild Area 2026 event on Nov. 14 and 15.

item.title: How to get Go Safari Balls in Pokémon Go
item.dc:creator: Julia Lee
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] As part of the “Wild Area: Global” Pokémon Go event, you can get Go Safari Balls, which have a high catch rate. We explain how to get more in our guide.
item.content:encoded: You can get Go Safari Balls as part of Pokémon Go Wild Area events, and can only be used during event hours. No, seriously — they disappear after the event ends.

item.title: 25 Years Later, Frodo’s Best Lord of the Ring Quote Proves He's the Ultimate Fantasy Hero
item.dc:creator: Aimee Hart
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective about 25-year-old film, lacks substance.] The Lord of the Rings is full of profound quotes, but Frodo's best one shows why he’s fantasy's greatest hero.
item.content:encoded: An inherent tragedy follows every character in The Lord of the Rings, which isn’t surprising, given that Peter Jackson’s epic fantasy trilogy is adapted from the works of J.R.R. Tolkien. The author has never been shy about exploring grim topics, and in a 1968 interview with the BBC, Tolkien said that all stories are about one thing: death.

item.title: HBO’s 5-Part Crime Drama Has One of the Best Seasons in TV History
item.dc:creator: Sam Nelson
item.description: [Filtered: Generic TV retrospective; not a new announcement or substantial news.] The Wire’s fourth season provided a far deeper look at Baltimore’s problems
item.content:encoded: At the turn of the 21st century, HBO was the place for prestige crime drama. The launch of The Sopranos in 1999 paved the way for the 2002 premiere of The Wire, which focused on drug dealers in Baltimore and the police officers trying to disrupt their operations. The series is still one of the best shows of all time, and provided breakout roles for huge stars like Idris Elba and Michael B. Jordan. But while it was compelling from the beginning, The Wire truly achieved perfection in season 4 when the scope expanded beyond the drug trade to examine the cycle of institutional failure.

item.title: 10 New Movies to Watch This Weekend on Netflix, Prime Video, and HBO Max (November 13 - 15)
item.dc:creator: Maria Loreto
item.description: [Filtered: Streaming clickbait list; not substantial film/TV coverage.] On this week's streaming column, there's one of the biggest dinosaur blockbusters of the year, a big horror movie, and much more.
item.content:encoded: Happy weekend! Several movies are hitting theaters this week, from the action-comedy How to Rob a Bank, starring Nicholas Hoult, Zoë Kravitz, and Christian Slater, to Ti West’s take on A Christmas Carol, titled Ebenezer and starring Johnny Depp.

item.title: Marvel Officially Confirms New Avengers Team for Doomsday
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester
item.description: [Filtered: Marvel/Avengers franchise churn casting news.] Marvel has confirmed what superheroes are apart of the newest Avengers team in Doomsday, which will also feature the Fantastic Four and X-Men.
item.content:encoded: The Marvel Cinematic Universe's Avengers lineup has been a bit muddled since the events of Captain America: Civil War, which broke up the team of besties. Things got more confusing when the team of misfits in last year's Thunderbolts* was declared the New Avengers at the end of the film, causing a bit of a kerfuffle between the team and Anthony Mackie's Sam Wilson/Captain America over who gets to call themselves Avengers.

item.title: Tom Hiddleston's Loki: A Marvel Series Evolution
item.dc:creator: Rachel Tolleson
item.description: [Filtered: Marvel TV series analysis, franchise churn without substance.] Explore how Tom Hiddleston's Loki redefined Marvel's storytelling.
item.content:encoded: Tom Hiddleston is possibly one of the busiest actors in Hollywood, and has been so for over a decade. 2026 saw him as Ed Hillary in Apple TV's Tenzing, and now he's returning to the stage to star in the Broadway adaptation of Much Ado About Nothing alongside fellow Marvel alum Hayley Atwell. His credits span genres, highlighting his versatility across film and television. However, there is one particular role that has defined Hiddleston's time in Hollywood, and one that fans still love today.

item.title: KPop Demon Hunters' 2027 World Tour Is Official, but There's a Catch
item.dc:creator: Aimee Hart
item.description: [Filtered: Entertainment news unrelated to games, horror, or relevant topics.] The official 'KPop Demon Hunters' world tour is here, but fans still have plenty of questions and few answers.
item.content:encoded: KPop Demon Hunters is packed with award-winning bops, so it’s no surprise Netflix and Sony Pictures Animation want to make the most of them with a live show. Netflix began planning a concert tour in March and confirmed today that Huntr/x will be going on tour in 2027. However, it's still unclear who will actually be performing the songs.

item.title: Avengers Endgame: Encore Now Officially Streaming on Disney Plus
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: [Filtered: Marvel streaming clickbait; big-franchise churn to discard.] Avengers Endgame: Encore just got released on Disney Plus streaming, letting viewers relive the Marvel Studios hit before Doomsday.
item.content:encoded: With Avengers: Doomsday roughly a month away, Disney has some good news for MCU fans who want to be fully caught up before Doctor Doom blows through the Marvel pantheon. Marvel Studios' Avengers Endgame: Encore is now streaming on Disney Plus.

item.title: Pixar's New Movie Gatto Gets First In-Depth Look in Official Trailer
item.dc:creator: Ashely Claudino
item.description: [Filtered: Generic film trailer; lacks substantive prestige or urgency.] Pixar takes viewers to Venice to meet a mobster cat in Gatto, starring Mark Ruffalo and Laurence Fishburne.
item.content:encoded: The first teaser for Gatto, Pixar's upcoming animated film, was released on Jun. 11, following a description of the movie's general plot and some cast members. Fans learned that Gatto is set in the Italian city of Venice, and it follows the adventures of a feral black cat named Nero, who's spent most of his nine lives recklessly working for mobster cat Rocco.

item.title: 6 Nintendo Switch Special Editions With the Best Designs, Ranked
item.dc:creator: Jason Venter
item.description: [Filtered: Hardware ranking list; filler nostalgia without game substance.] Even when a person already owns a Switch, some of these are attractive enough to make them want to buy another one.
item.content:encoded: When a new console arrives, a lot of us rush out to buy one the minute we can afford to. At launch, there’s typically just one option, or sometimes a handful of choices with varying specifications. Personality isn’t a draw yet, beyond whatever’s standard. Over time, however, that inevitably changes.

item.title: 5 Sci-Fi Book Trilogies Where Every Entry Is Perfect
item.dc:creator: Debopriyaa Dutta
item.description: [Filtered: Book recommendations; outside games/horror scope.] Not all sci-fi trilogies are made equal, as some are impeccable from start to finish.
item.content:encoded: Of course, not all sci-fi trilogies are created equal. Plenty start strong only to flame out in book two or three, while others admittedly take a while to get good. But there are plenty of perfect trilogies, too. Polygon has rounded up five sci-fi book trilogies that are worth your time from start to finish. Check out the list below.

item.title: 5 Funniest 'Peanuts' Comics About Food Only Charles Schulz Could Come Up With
item.dc:creator: Thomas Hindmarch
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective about old comic strip gags; generic listicle filler.] Here's the World Famous Gastronomer reading 50 years of food gags
item.content:encoded: There aren't quite as many Peanuts comic strips focused on food as one might expect. Little kids do tend to live their lives in the windows between meals and snacks, and Snoopy is as obsessed with his suppertime as any other dog, but food humor was a relatively low priority in Charles Schulz's punchline rotation. Compared to baseball, philosophy, Snoopy's alternate personas, or Charlie Brown's truly existential levels of depression, food as a topic in Peanuts was kept on a low boil.

item.title: 44 Years Later, Star Trek’s Best Quote About Grief Is Still a Near-Perfect Sci-Fi Moment
item.dc:creator: Rachel Leishman
item.description: [Filtered: 44-year-old nostalgia retrospective without real substance about old film.] Star Trek has some of the best moments in science fiction. And its best quote about grief is part of that.
item.content:encoded: Franchises often help us understand the pain of loss. Shows like WandaVision have been praised for their exploration of grief and the anguish that exists there. But other franchises have also explored the feelings that surround death and grief. One of the biggest science fiction franchises of all time is known for quite a few poignant moments exploring what death can bring to those who are left behind. That franchise is Star Trekand trying to figure out the best approach to loss is hard because each of the franchise's iconic series has had moments that are worth talking about.

item.title: 'Avatar: Seven Havens’ Season 2 Release Date Announcement Includes Some Shocking Good News
item.dc:creator: Corey Plante
item.description: [Filtered: Generic animated series renewal/news, not prestige or horror content.] Avatar: Seven Havens seasons 2 and 3 will arrive next year, and Paramount has already revealed what Pavi and Nisha's journey will look like.
item.content:encoded: Avatar: Seven Havens spent its entire first season in the Haven of Ellora, but as the show's title makes clear, that's just one of many Havens spread across this post-apocalyptic landscape. Paramount Plus announced Thursday that Book 2: Discovery premieres surprisingly soon, while also confirming that Avatar Pavi’s (Saheli Khan) journey to repair the broken world is about to pick up speed. The announcement, which also confirms Avatar: Seven Havens Book 3 will come soon after Book 2, includes a synopsis that answers some of our most pressing questions following the season 1 finale: Is this now Pavi’s story? What will happen to Nisha (Aishu Devan)? Where will the plot take them and when will they reunite? Already, we’re getting answers to these and other questions.

item.title: Daniel Craig's Most Disappointing Bond Film Quietly Exits Streaming This Month
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.description: [Filtered: Streaming clickbait about content leaving a service.] James Bond fans have limited time to watch Quantum of Solace on Paramount+, as Daniel Craig’s 2008 action thriller prepares to leave.
item.content:encoded: Daniel Craig's time as James Bond may be over, but his legacy as the iconic British spy is still being felt across Hollywood. After five films and 15 years in the role, Craig helped usher in a grittier era for the long-running franchise, delivering some of 007's most memorable big-screen adventures along the way.

item.title: Ghost Rider Star Says He's Down to Return for Marvel's 2028 Reboot
item.dc:creator: Michael McWhertor
item.description: [Filtered: Marvel franchise casting gossip and spinoff news.] Agents of SHIELD's Gabriel Luna is open to reprising his role as Ghost Rider Robbie Reyes if Marvel Studios calls.
item.content:encoded: Marvel Studios is bringing back the supernatural hero Ghost Rider in a new movie in 2028, with Ryan Gosling in the lead role. Exactly which version of Ghost Rider Gosling will tackle remains unclear, but one former actor who donned the flaming skull says he's down to ride alongside the rebooted silver screen Spirit of Vengeance if Marvel calls: Agents of SHIELD star Gabriel Luna.

item.title: How to farm rupees in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Josh Broadwell
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] You have a few rupee farming methods in Zelda Ocarina of Time depending on which timeline you're in. These are the best ways to get rupees in OoT.
item.content:encoded: Rupee farming in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake looks a bit different than you might be used to if you played the N64 original or any of its later ports. The most common method in older versions of the game — getting some red rupees above the Castle Town drawbridge — doesn't work anymore. However, there are several other quick and straightforward ways to fill your wallet, whatever size it is.

item.title: Marvel’s Kevin Feige Breaks Silence on MCU Doctor Doom Being a Tony Stark Variant
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester
item.description: [Filtered: Marvel/Avengers franchise gossip and speculation.] Marvel Studios Kevin Feige has shot down the idea that Avengers Doomsday's Doctor Doom is a variant of Tony Stark.
item.content:encoded: Robert Downey Jr.'s surprise casting as Doctor Doom in December's Avengers: Doomsday resulted in Marvel fans wondering if the Doomsday villain would be a multiversal variant of Tony Stark/Iron Man, the character Downey played for over a decade. More fuel was added to the fire when Red Guardian actor David Harbour hinted that Doom's face would be revealed to look like Stark back in August, but the actor later walked back those comments.

item.title: Where to find the Daikoku area in Forza Horizon 6
item.dc:creator: Paulo Kawanishi
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's where to find the Daikoku area in Forza Horizon 6, so you can complete the Series 7 "City Life" collectible Smashapon weekly challenge.
item.content:encoded: In Forza Horizon 6, you can visit Daikoku, a famous area for those who enjoy Japanese automotive culture. It's located in the Tokyo City region and, in real life, it's well-known for hosting car meets — just like the in-game ones you can take part in if you stop by the Daikoku Parking Area.

item.title: Star Wars 50th Anniversary Release Will Include New Music from John Williams
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester
item.category: Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope
item.description: [Filtered: Star Wars big-franchise churn about anniversary re-release.] The original version of Star Wars is heading to theaters next year, and it will briefly include new music from Star Wars composer John Williams.

item.title: Lord of the Rings Officially Reveals Gollum’s Replacement
item.dc:creator: Rachel Leishman
item.category: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
item.description: [Filtered: Big-franchise churn: Lord of the Rings casting/character gossip.] The franchise has brought in a new character that fills the hole that Gollum once filled with Samwise and Frodo.
item.content:encoded: The Lord of the Ringshas a lot going for it right now. Next year, The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum is set to release from director Andy Serkis, who brought Gollum to life in Peter Jackson's The Lord of the Rings trilogy as well as the trilogy for The Hobbit. He is, in many ways, the most iconic character in the franchise and is easily the most quoted. You can't talk about Lord of the Rings without someone saying "My precious." Now though, a new character has taken the place of Gollum within the franchise. Meaning a new creature being dragged into things with our main characters.

item.title: 10 Funniest 'Far Side' Comics About Penguins That Prove Gary Larson Is Unbeatable
item.dc:creator: Brian VanHooker
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective about old comics, not new content.] In addition to cows and dinosaurs, Gary Larson loved to make fun of penguins. Here are his 10 best penguin-focused Far Side comics
item.content:encoded: Everybody agrees that penguins are funny. They walk funny. They sound funny. They all look like they’re wearing tiny little tuxedos. They’re birds, but they can’t fly — that’s very funny. They live in utterly ridiculous places, and they fall down all the time.

item.title: Clint Eastwood's Legendary Western Sequel Is Waiting to Be Discovered on Streaming
item.dc:creator: Brian VanHooker
item.description: [Filtered: Streaming clickbait: old classic film available on free platform.] The second film in Clint Eastwood's "The Man with No Name Trilogy," For a Few Dollars More, is free on youtube, making this perfect time to watch
item.content:encoded: In 1964, Italian director Sergio Leone redefined the Western movie genre with A Fistful of Dollars. Eschewing the relatively simplistic morality tales of earlier films, Leone’s protagonist wasn’t a noble hero, but an opportunistic gunslinger who pits two rival Old West gangs against each other to score a big payday. Despite the moral complexity of it all — or, more likely, because of it — A Fistful of Dollars was an international success that proved three things: audiences were ready for a new kind of Western, America no longer had a monopoly on the genre, and Clint Eastwood was a bankable movie star.

item.title: Legend of Zelda Officially Returns to The Wilds Era in December
item.dc:creator: Ashley Potter
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
item.description: [Filtered: Collectible merchandise/restock news, not game-related.] Collectors score as a Tears of the Kingdom Link statue gets a rerelease next month.
item.content:encoded: All eyes are on The Legend of Zeldaright now — and for good reason. The franchise is currently in the midst of celebrating its 40th anniversary and the long-awaited remake of Ocarina of Time was released on Nov. 5, 2026, becoming the second best-selling game on the Nintendo Switch 2 less than a week after its release. But, even amid all the Ocarina excitement, it's hard to forget just how memorable earlier Switch-era Zelda titles were — particularly Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom.

item.title: Netflix's Hit Spy Thriller Returns and Takes Over Streaming Charts
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.description: [Filtered: Generic TV renewal with streaming chart clickbait.] Netflix’s Black Doves is back with new episodes, and Keira Knightley’s spy thriller is climbing the streaming charts.
item.content:encoded: Keira Knightley has a knack for playing smart, determined women who refuse to back down when things get dangerous. Whether she's exposing government secrets in Official Secrets, investigating a serial killer in Boston Strangler, or navigating a deadly mystery aboard a luxury yacht in Netflix's The Woman in Cabin 10, Knightley has become a natural fit for tense thrillers.

item.title: All Bomb Bag upgrade locations in Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Julia Lee
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's where you can find the two Bomb Bag upgrades in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake.
item.content:encoded: You can upgrade your Bomb Bag in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Timeremake, allowing you to carry more bombs and make more enemies explode. While not required to beat the game, if you want to be able to fling bombs freely, you should definitely upgrade your Bomb Bags and max out their capacity.

item.title: Marvel Makes VisionQuest’s First Episode Free To Stream
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester
item.description: [Filtered: Streaming clickbait about free episode on YouTube; Marvel franchise.] Marvel and Disney have uploaded the first episode of VisionQuest to YouTube, meaning you can now check it out for free.
item.content:encoded: VisionQuest came to an end this week, putting a bow on one of Marvel's best Disney Plus shows ahead of the Marvel Cinematic Universe's next blockbuster film, December's Avengers: Doomsday. If you're curious about the show, but don't have a Disney Plus subscription (and after its recent price hikes, who can blame you), Marvel and Disney have made the first episode of VisionQuest free to watch on YouTube.

item.title: How to get the Goron Tunic in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Paulo Kawanishi
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's how to get the Goron Tunic in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake so you can survive the extreme heat of Death Mountain Crater
item.content:encoded: The Goron Tunic is a unique piece of equipment that allows Link to withstand high temperatures in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. If you try to explore the Death Mountain Crater without this item, Link's clothes will catch fire, and he will start losing health. While entering such a dangerous place might not sound like a good idea, you can't actually avoid it, as you'll need to traverse the area to reach the Fire Temple during the story.

item.title: All Deku-Seed Bag upgrade locations in Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Julia Lee
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's where you can upgrade how many seeds you carry around for your Fairy Slingshot in the Ocarina of Time remake.
item.content:encoded: Deku-Seed Bag upgrades are a must in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, if you want to be able to beam your opponents from afar without worrying about running out of seeds. Not to be confused with the Deku-Nut Bag, which holds the nuts you can use to flash-stun enemies, the Deku-Seed Bag holds ammo for your Fairy Slingshot.

item.title: All Deku-Nut Bag upgrade locations in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Paulo Kawanishi
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here are all the Deku-Nut Bag upgrade locations in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, and the prerequisites to unlock the upgrades.
item.content:encoded: Upgrading Link's Deku-Nut Bag increases the number of flashy nuts that you carry in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. As young Link, Deku nuts are extremely useful items, as they stun enemies and create the perfect moment to attack. Unfortunately, you can carry a limited number of nuts early in the game. However, if you know where to look — and which holes to jump into — you can find bigger bags to carry more nuts.

item.title: 2024's Most Controversial Western Thriller Is Suddenly a Hit on Prime Video
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.description: [Filtered: Streaming clickbait; not prestige/anticipated film; controversial drama.] Alec Baldwin’s Western Rust is climbing Amazon Prime Video’s charts, years after its controversial production and limited release.
item.content:encoded: Alec Baldwin has spent decades as one of Hollywood's most recognizable actors, moving between blockbuster movies, acclaimed dramas, and television comedy. From The Hunt for Red October and Glengarry Glen Ross to The Departed and The Aviator, Baldwin has built an extensive filmography, while his Emmy-winning role as Jack Donaghy in 30 Rock remains one of his most memorable performances.

item.title: All Deku-Stick Bag upgrade locations in Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Julia Lee
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's where you can find the two Deku-Stick Bag upgrades in the Ocarina of Time remake.
item.content:encoded: If you love using Deku Sticks as a weapon in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Timeremake, you'll want to upgrade your Deku-Stick Bag to carry even more sticks. You can do this pretty early in the game, but this isn't really necessary to beat the main story. Most people will beat the game without upgrading their stick bag, but if you want to do everything there is to do, don't skip out on these bag upgrades.

item.title: Gerudo Proving Grounds walkthrough in Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Johnny Yu
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] The Gerudo Proving Grounds is a mini dungeon in Ocarina of Time. Here's how to complete it and get the Ice Arrows.
item.content:encoded: The Gerudo Proving Grounds is an area in Gerudo Fortress where you can test your battle prowess in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake.

item.title: Lanterns Producer Officially Responds to Show Cancellation Rumors
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester
item.description: [Filtered: DC/Green Lantern franchise gossip and cancellation rumors.] Rumors have bubbled up that Lanterns has been canceled. A writer and producer on it has denied them, though Lanterns has still yet to be renewed.
item.content:encoded: DC Studios bosses James Gunn and Peter Safran stepped down from their posts on Monday. Skydance, which recently acquired DC parent company Warner Bros. Discovery, replaced them with former Marvel producer Jeremy Latcham, resulting in plenty of questions about the future of the nascent DC Universe. Rumors swirled that the hit DCU show Lanterns, which recently wrapped up its first season, was canceled after Variety reported it wasn't renewed; it was later updated to say the show "has yet" to be renewed for season 2.

item.title: All 8 Zelda: Ocarina of Time Dungeons, Ranked From Worst to Best
item.dc:creator: Giovanni Colantonio
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Ranked list/tier list format, filler content.] The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's Switch 2 remake is a great reminder of Nintendo's excellent dungeon design.
item.content:encoded: While every moment of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is memorable, it’s the Nintendo 64 game’s dungeons that really stick in your memory. Each one is a tightly constructed puzzle box built around the tools you collect inside, culminating in an often-excellent boss fight. The game’s terrific Switch 2 remake doesn’t mess with that strength; it only refines some of Zelda’s best dungeons in tasteful ways.

item.title: Where are all the rings in The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power season 3?
item.dc:creator: Sam Nelson
item.category: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
item.description: [Filtered: Explainer/guide for prestige TV, not genuine news.] One ring to find them
item.content:encoded: As the name of the series implies, The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Poweris focused on how the Dark Lord Sauron (Charlie Vickers) forged the Rings of Power as part of a scheme to control all of Middle-earth. As of season 3, the three Elven Rings, Seven Rings for the Dwarf-lords, and the Nine Rings for Mortal Men have all been made, while Sauron is working endlessly to complete his project by building the One Ring to rule them all.

item.title: Rings of Power Episode 4 Ending Explained: What Happens to Galadriel, Celeborn, and Arondir?
item.dc:creator: Corey Plante
item.category: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
item.description: [Filtered: Episode explainer/recap, not substantive film/TV analysis.] The Rings of Power season 3 episode 4 includes a shocking death, a major transformation, and the return of a lost hero.
item.content:encoded: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power season 3 sees Middle-earth in the midst of full-on war as Sauron (Charlie Vickers) continues his conquest. Yet he still hasn’t figured out how to forge the one weapon he knows will solidify his title as the Dark Lord: the One Ring.

item.title: VisionQuest’s Post-Credits Scene Official Confirms Another Avenger Returning in Doomsday
item.dc:creator: Sam Nelson
item.category: Doctor Strange In the Multiverse of Madness
item.description: [Filtered: Marvel/Avengers casting and plot gossip.] VisionQuest's finale just confirmed that an Avenger is returning from the dead for Doomsday.
item.content:encoded: VisionQuestcompleted the story that began in 2020 with WandaVision, bringing things full circle by again using the framing of classic sitcoms as a way to tell a deep story about grief and family. The VisionQuest finale was released on Nov. 10, and viewers will want to keep watching through the credits, which include a pair of scenes with big implications for the future of the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

item.title: In One Scene, Prime Video Officially Rewrites Gandalf’s Mission in Lord of the Rings
item.dc:creator: Sam Nelson
item.category: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
item.description: [Filtered: Episode explainer for prestige fantasy TV.] Gandalf isn’t just an old man, he’s a divine guardian, as we learn in Lord of the Rings: The RIngs of Power season 3
item.content:encoded: By the end of The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Powerseason 2, Gandalf (Daniel Weyman) had chosen his name and wizard staff and found a mentor in the enigmatic Tom Bombadil (Rory Kinnear). Season 3 picks up five years later, and Gandalf has spent that time vexing the Dark Wizard (Ciarán Hinds) and his forces in Rhûn. Gandalf sees the Dark Wizard as a dangerous foe, but their relationship is more complicated. Here’s what you need to know about the two wizards, and how they fit into J.R.R. Tolkien’s complex cosmology.

item.title: Disney's Legendary 218-Episode Sci-Fi Series Is the Perfect Anti-'Lanterns' Binge
item.dc:creator: Brian VanHooker
item.description: [Filtered: Streaming clickbait about X-Files; Lanterns is big-franchise churn.] The DC Universe might be doomed, but X-Files is forever
item.content:encoded: The fate of Lanterns season 2, and the DC Universe in general, has never been murkier. With the sudden ousting of DC Studios' co-CEOs James Gunn and Peter Safran, the status of HBO's hit show series about two mismatched Green Lanterns who get paired together to solve an intergalactic mystery is up in the air like never before. Season 1 was a critical hit that captured the zeitgeist, and Lanterns co-creator Chris Mundy had already assembled a season 2 writers' room. But in a recent interview, Mundy said the odds of the series continuing were likely "50/50.”

item.title: 5 Funniest Quotes from 'Calvin and Hobbes’ Babysitter Rosalyn
item.dc:creator: Brian VanHooker
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective about old comic strip quotes.] Rosalyn the babysitter used to hurl all kinds of insults at Calvin. These are the best of them.
item.content:encoded: To put it mildly, Calvin got on the nerves of a lot of people in Calvin and Hobbes. First off, there was his mother, who Calvin fought with over her terrible cooking and going to school in the morning. He also frustrated his father, particularly when Calvin would break something costly, like a pair of fancy binoculars or part of the family car. Calvin ticked off his neighbor Susie, too, and even his teacher, Miss Wormwood.

item.title: 10 Best Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave Replacements
item.dc:creator: Jen Glennon
item.description: [Filtered: Game recommendations/alternatives list; filler-adjacent content.] If Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave has got you craving more tactical battles and plenty of allies to recruit, here are a few of our favorites
item.content:encoded: It's been several weeks now since Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weavewas released for Nintendo Switch 2, and fans around the world are still exploring this massive game. While you could easily sink hundreds of hours into playing through every Flame Lord's story, you may be wondering what to play after your adventures in Dagda are through. Worry not: we've compiled a list of games like Fortune's Weave to keep your strategic skills sharp while you wait for the story expansion DLC that's slated to be released sometime in 2027. While many of the games on this list are strategy RPGs, some incorporate other standout elements of Fortune's Weave, like its tournament-focused story or the opportunity to recruit dozens of allies.

item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] The Sinking Lure makes fishing easier in Ocarina of Time, but also helps hook the Hylian loach. Here's where it's located and how to get it.
item.content:encoded: The Sinking Lure is an optional item you can find in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, but the conditions for finding it are a little confusing. The lure itself isn't necessary for beating the game, and you can't even leave the fishing pond with it, so don't fret if this is something you're stuck on.

item.title: Nobody Said The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Was This Funny
item.dc:creator: Jen Glennon
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective of old game with no new substance.] It may be impossible to play Zelda: Ocarina of Time totally free of spoilers in 2026, but the jokes are 100% fresh.
item.content:encoded: Though I’ve never played The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time until now, I’ve heard people sing its praises for years. Mostly, this revolved around its impossibly high score of 99 on Metacritic, its influential open world and combat design, and its memorable dungeons. But none of those ardent fans bothered to tell me that this classic game has some genuinely hilarious moments. Because the game was originally released 28 years ago, a spoiler-free experience is pretty much off the table for me. But the goofs and gags? Those are all 100% fresh.
